title: Property tests for the DSL round-trip and the fractional-index order keys
description:
No property or fuzz testing exists in the workspace (no proptest, quickcheck or cargo-fuzz in `Cargo.lock`). `crates/apricity-data/src/position.rs` has 22 non-test `unwrap()` calls (for example 108, 122, 187, 200, 234, 362, 370), mixes char and byte indexing (`&key[..len]`, `&a[1..]`), computes `digit_b - digit_a` on `usize` (360), and silently swaps out-of-order bounds at 408 instead of returning an error. It is guarded today only by `validate_order_key` (397-402).

Done when: proptest covers `dsl::parse ∘ dsl::format` as an identity on generated scores and `position` key generation as always strictly between its bounds and always valid; the swapped-bounds path returns an error; the unwraps become typed errors.
